title: HoloMap Field Intel
subtitle: Markers should tell you risk, route status, and preparation
summary: Ashfall HoloMap markers are not collectibles. They are route decisions with risk labels, prep notes, and discovery states.
body: Track one first-month marker at a time. Survivor Cache Signal is a safe resupply lead; toxic and reactor markers are warnings until counterplay exists.
Use filters to separate safe zones, POI signals, field caches, hazards, and faction markers.
If a marker lacks a name, icon, risk label, or route reason, treat it as incomplete content and report it in smoke notes.
